title: Static on Pier Nine
tagline: A pledge night, a pirate broadcast, and a fired DJ everyone wants to blame.
role: You volunteer one night a month as the signal analyst for KPIR 91.3, Pier Nine Radio. The station runs Google SecOps. You have read access to Search and nothing else.
opening: Pledge Night at Pier Nine Radio is the one night the station's phones never stop. At 03:10, between a jazz block and the overnight news, the playout system aired a segment nobody scheduled: a distorted voice reading the names of the night's biggest donors, one by one, followed by forty seconds of static.

By 03:14 the board treasurer, Hal Brunner, was in the control room. By 03:20 he had a suspect: Marco Vela, the overnight host the station let go last week, who still knows every password on the pier. Station manager Odalys Reyes is not ready to call anyone. 'Bring me what the logs say,' she tells you. 'Not what the room thinks.'
The station's events are in Google SecOps. You have until the morning news to work out what happened, in what order, and who needs to be told.
